errors.unreachable: The camera did not answer. Check that it is on and on the same network as Homey.
errors.login_failed: The camera did not accept the username or password, or this user has too few rights. Check the user in the camera (Settings > System > Users): it needs Operator or Administrator rights. Then tap Repair on the device to type the login again.
errors.forbidden: The camera user may not do this. Give the user Operator rights in the camera (Settings > System > Users).
errors.cert_changed: Another device answers at this camera's address (its security certificate changed). Check the address in the device settings.
errors.not_supported: This camera does not have this function, or its AXIS OS is too old for it.
errors.bad_response: The camera gave an answer the app could not read.
errors.too_many_streams: Too many cameras are being watched at once. Close one and try again.
errors.no_picture: The camera did not send a picture.
errors.bad_address: Type the camera's address without http:// or slashes, for example 192.168.1.20, or 192.168.1.20:8443 with a port.
errors.no_scenario: That Object Analytics scenario no longer exists on the camera. Pick it again in the flow card.

pair.loginRefused: __n__ camera(s) did not accept this username or password: __list__. Check the login on these cameras and try again.
pair.title: Log in to your cameras
pair.intro: Type the username and password you use on your cameras. Homey then looks for Axis cameras on its network and lists the ones that accept this login.
pair.addressesHint: Leave this empty: Homey searches its own network and the networks of cameras you added before. Only needed if some cameras aren't found. Type IP addresses or a whole network, separated by commas. Example: 192.168.40.10, 192.168.40.0/24
pair.searching: Looking for cameras. This can take up to 30 seconds…
pair.badAddress: "__address__" doesn't look like an address. Examples: 192.168.40.10, 192.168.40.10:8443, 192.168.40.0/24 or 192.168.40.10-40 (networks up to 1024 addresses).
pair.noneFound: No new Axis cameras were found on Homey's network. If your cameras are on a separate network, go back and type their IP addresses under "Camera addresses". You can find the address in the camera's own web page or in AXIS IP Utility.

address.unreachable: __address__: no Axis camera answered. Check the address, and that Homey can reach that network.
address.noAnswer: __address__: the camera didn't answer in time. Try again, or check the address.
address.loginFailed: __address__: the camera did not accept this username or password.
address.notCamera: __address__ is an Axis device, but not a camera. Only cameras can be added for now.

pair.noAddress: Type at least one camera address, for example 192.168.2.10
pair.addressIntro: Homey didn't find any new Axis cameras on its own network. This is normal when the cameras are on a separate network, for example 192.168.40.x while Homey is on 192.168.10.x.
pair.addressHint: Type each camera's IP address, separated by commas, or a whole network to search, like 192.168.40.0/24 or 192.168.40.10-40. Add a port if the camera's web page isn't on the usual one, like 192.168.40.10:8443.

device.restarting: The camera is restarting. It will be back in about a minute.
device.limitedRights: The camera user Homey logs in with has limited rights (for example Viewer). Pictures, live view and events work, but privacy mode, restart and some settings need an Administrator user. Change the user's rights in the camera (Settings > System > Users), or tap Repair to use another user.

settings.title: Cameras for AXIS
settings.subtitle: Your cameras and diagnostics.
settings.noCameras: No cameras yet. Add one with + > Cameras for AXIS.
settings.diagnosticsHint: Only switch this on when you are asked to, for example to report a problem. The log stays on your Homey.

problems.poe: Power over the network cable (PoE) has a problem

widget.missing: This camera is no longer in Homey. Pick another one in the widget settings.
widget.pickCamera: Pick a camera in the widget settings.
widget.noCameras: No cameras yet. Add one with + > Cameras for AXIS.
widget.notTracking: Switch on 'Track and count people and vehicles' in this camera's settings to start counting.
widget.heatEmpty: No paths yet. They appear here as people and vehicles pass.
widget.tagShown: A card or tag was shown

tampering.scene: the view changed all at once
